title.narrative: Digital Transformation Centre: Improving the Digital Innovation Ecosystem in Nigeria

description.narrative:
The Action aims to support the improvement of Nigeria¿s digital innovation ecosystem. It contributes to the EU¿s partnership with Africa on the transition to the digital age and the Communication ¿2030 Digital Compass: the European way for the Digital Decade¿. It is part of the EU Action Document on supporting Innovation and Jobs for Youth in Nigeria (INN-JOBS). The Action will strengthen the EU's engagement in the sector by helping Nigeria leverage the EU's extensive experience in digital transformation of MSMEs, innovation ecosystem building, and human-centered innovation and digitalisation legal frameworks, which will benefit both the country's development (human-centered approach) and the EU's interests.

The Multi-Donor Action ¿Digital Transformation Centre: Improving the Digital Innovation Ecosystem in Nigeria¿ is jointly co-financed by the European Union and the Federal Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by GIZ as part of the BMZ project ¿Digital Solutions for Sustainable Development in Nigeria (Digital Transformation Centre Nigeria)¿. The duration of this Action is scheduled from 01.11.2022 to 31.10.2025 (36 months) with a total EU contribution of ¿ 9.5 million.

title.narrative: Specific objective indicator 2Number of organisations benefiting from capacity building measures

description.narrative: Analysis of an OnlineSurvey of the supported innovation support organisations (e.g., DIH, hubs, accelerators, incubators, etc.) through capacity building measures with a standardised questionnaire on capacity enhancements based on the following criteria(a) Skill and capacity enhancement to support MSMEs and startups throughout their digital transformation and/or innovation lifecycle, (b) Development of beneficial partnerships with European counterparts (c) Contribution to the improvement of the innovation ecosystem, and based on a 5point scale with: (1) not at all improved to (5) very improved.
